stem_book: Passage: A covalent bond will be formed by the overlapping of atomic orbitals having single electron of opposite spin; according to the overlapping of atomic orbitals the covalent bond may be of two types: (i) Sigma bond (σ) (ii) Pi bond (π). Sigma bond is stronger bond than the Pi-bond. If atomic orbitals overlap about the nuclear axis then sigma bond is formed but when atomic orbitals overlap sideway then Pi-bond is formed. (i) The correct order of increasing C—O bond length of CO, CO₃²⁻, CO₂ is (a) CO₃²⁻ < CO₂ < CO (b) CO₂ < CO₃²⁻ < CO (c) CO < CO₃²⁻ < CO₂ (d) CO < CO₂ < CO₃²⁻. (ii) Compound having maximum bond angle is (a) BBr₃ (b) BCl₃ (c) BF₃ (d) None of these. (iii) The strength of bonds formed by 2s–2s, 2p–2p and 2p–2s overlap has the order (a) s–s > p–p > p–s (b) s–s > p–s > p–p (c) p–p > p–s > s–s (d) p–p > s–s > p–s
